scenes.text: An array has 2 rows of 3 counters. How many counters are in the array? Let us think carefully. Use repeated addition: add 3 exactly 2 times. The answer is 6. Great work!
Follow the rule add 4: 9, 13, 17, blank . What is missing? Let us think carefully. Add 4 one more time. The answer is 21. Great work!
Follow the rule subtract 4: 66, 62, 58, blank . What is missing? Let us think carefully. Subtract 4 one more time. The answer is 54. Great work!
An array has 5 rows of 6 counters. How many counters are in the array? Let us think carefully. Use repeated addition: add 6 exactly 5 times. The answer is 30. Great work!
